$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
Write-Output '=== RUNNER PROCESSES ==='
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Runner\.(Listener|Worker)' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'actions-runner|Runner\.Listener|Runner\.Worker' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CreationDate,CommandLine | Format-List
Write-Output '=== RUNNER SERVICES ==='
Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'actions|runner' -or $_.DisplayName -match 'Actions|Runner' } | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,Status,StartType | Format-Table -AutoSize
Write-Output '=== RUNNER DIRS ==='
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:USERPROFILE -Directory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'runner|actions' } | Select-Object FullName | Format-Table -AutoSize
Write-Output '=== SYSTEM ==='
$principal=[Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
Write-Output ("User={0} Elevated={1}" -f [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name, $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator))
